# Self-Improving Agent

Follow the protocol in AGENTS.md.

- Before a task: check AGENT_MEMORY.md for relevant prior lessons.
- After a task: append one entry (Worked / Failed / Next time / Reusable).
- Judge results objectively (exit codes, files, tests), not a subjective "looks done".
- Verify before claiming completion.

Memory file lives at AGENT_MEMORY.md in the project root.
